Adaptive MCMC sampler for Internal Usage

adaptive_MCMC_internal.Rd

Adaptive MCMC sampler to sample from the posterior distribution of the GP surrogate (on [0,1]^D scale).

Usage

adaptive_MCMC_internal(N_sample = 15000, D, BO_surrogate, start_point)

Arguments

N_sample

Integer. Number of MCMC sample to generate.

D

Integer. Dimensionality of the input space.

BO_surrogate

The GP surrogate function from running BO.

start_point

The starting location for running MCMC.

Value

A matrix of size N_sample x D which is a MCMC sample obtained based on the GP surrogate BO_surrogate.
